description: E-SQL: Direct Schema Linking via Question Enrichment in Text-to-SQL

tasks.name: esql_candidate_generation
tasks.description: Stage 1: Candidate SQL Generation - generates initial SQL using original question + full schema + DB samples + column descriptions

tasks.name: esql_question_enrichment
tasks.description: Stage 2: Question Enrichment - enriches the question by directly linking relevant database items (tables, columns, values) and candidate predicates into the natural language query

tasks.name: esql_sql_refinement
tasks.description: Stage 3: SQL Refinement - refines the candidate SQL using the enriched question + candidate predicates + execution feedback
